idle.about: Guard, breathing: a heavy dwarf at rest with the axe held two-handed across the body. The stance every other clip starts and ends on.

walk.about: A stocky, grounded march with short steps, the axe carried at guard; the game moves him at its travel.

attack.about: A two-handed overhead chop: a settle, a held wind-up behind the head, the hips leading the strike, and a heavy follow-through back to guard.
